title: Lost All My Notes!
body: Just lost all my works for the past 10 years, all my notes turned into tasks and with each login the content disappeared and left only a checkbox. 3 Novels, Rap Lyrics. Personal Philosophical arguments, Plans and side notes gone just like that!
